input:
Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
这个男孩子叫孟子，孟子是古代的人。孟子的妈妈觉得住在哪儿对童年很重要，所以他们常常搬了家。她望子成龙，所以孟子的妈妈安排他的生活。

This scene:
因为他们常常搬了家，中国人说，孟母三迁。孟子没有爸爸，所以，他的妈妈更重要。从这儿到那儿，妈妈教孟子很多技能。先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿，然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the mother’s lessons, add Mengzi’s reaction to show his feelings: “孟子觉得这些本领很有意思。”
2. At the point where the mother teaches shopping, add a short line of speech: “妈妈说：‘买东西要又便宜又质量好。’”
3. Add one concrete detail about the shopping lesson: “妈妈带孟子去市场，看不同商人卖的东西。”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple, fitting feeling without changing the event.
It mostly repeats that the mother teaches him to buy cheap, good-quality things.
A market visit and different merchants are invented details not part of the traditional tale.
